reproduction.method: Counted sum-product elimination versus exhaustive enumeration on random chain DAGs
reproduction.description: Compare exact conditional marginals and actual multiplication counts as categorical state count grows.
differences: A random six-node chain DAG with random normalized CPTs replaces the original large random multi-parent DAG.
State counts 2–5 keep enumeration bounded; the final node is observed in state zero.
Operation counts are instrumented in these TypeScript algorithms, not MATLAB/libDAI wall-clock timings, asymptotic guesses, or benchmark speedups.
